main_body: Shrine building with large teal tiled roof, red timber frame, white plaster walls, and central double doors
top_band: teal roof ridge and pitched tile roof surface from row 4 to row 42 (with gold katsuogi ornaments at rows 0-3)
evidence: The large pitched teal roof occupies rows 4-42 above the horizontal red beam and front facade (rows 43-78). Row 43 is a bright orange-red front edge highlight of the lintel/eave, row 46 is a dark shadow line under the beam, and the central dark brown lattice doors are recessed behind the pillars and shimenawa.

style.evidence: The teal roof has 6 distinct shades with individual tile highlights and vertical ridges; the plaster walls have subtle speckle noise, the lattice doors and stone base are well-textured, and outlines use dark material tones (dark teal/brown, dark red, dark grey) matching the Beodeul reference standard.
